name: Amenae
source:
Amenae is afflicted with some form of color blindness where every color except red appears as monochrome. [spoiler]This leads to her having a fascination with the color red and she eventually develops an deranged blood lust, as blood is one of the few things she can see properly. This eventually causes her to commit seemingly random acts of murder.

Mother of the Lirit twins. She was given her name by her childhood friend Mallory whom she met in the orphanage where they grew up.[/spoiler]
